optimizedDescription.value: Normalized JSON-serializable AST contract lets every ArtifactParser parse and serialize Markdown, YAML, JSON, and plaintext.

optimizedContext.value:
# Artifact AST

## Rules
- Every normalized node plain object: required string `type`; optional string `label`; optional scalar `value` (`string | number | boolean | null`) or ordered `children`, never both. Node may have neither.
- Markdown: `document`; nested heading `section` (`label`, `level` 1–6, `children`); `paragraph` (`value`); `list` (`ordered`, `children`); `list-item` (`label`, optional nested-list `children`); `code-block` (language `label`, `value`); `thematic-break`. Section parent = nearest preceding lower-level section; levels may skip.
- YAML: `document` has top mapping pairs or one sequence; `mapping` → `pair`; `pair` has key `label` + scalar `value` or one nested `mapping|sequence`; `sequence` → `sequence-item`; item scalar `value` or one nested `mapping|sequence`.
- JSON: `document` has one root; `object` → `property`; `property` key `label` + scalar `value` or one `object|array`; `array` → `array-item`; item scalar `value` or one `object|array`.
- Plaintext: `document`; blank-line-separated `paragraph` (`value`); `line` (`value`).
- Every adapter serializes normalized AST native format. Preserve all `label`, `value`, `children`; Markdown heading levels, `ordered`, code language, nesting, untouched inline-format metadata; source style `bullet`, `emphasis`, `strong` when clear, else deterministic convention. YAML mapping order and supported CST comments; JSON key order + two-space formatting. Preserve unrepresentable inline Markdown as `value` text.

## Constraints
- `label` only primary-identifier node types; absent on `document`, `paragraph`, `list`, `sequence`, `array`, `object`, `thematic-break`.
- Fields JSON-serializable: no functions, circular references, class instances.
- Only adapter parses/serializes native format; all other components use normalized AST.
